===== README =====
# Acme Storefront

A small static shop site: six pages, shared CSS, no build step.

```
site/
  index.html  products.html  pricing.html  orders.html  about.html  contact.html
  css/tokens.css      design tokens and the web font
  css/base.css        reset, typography, layout
  css/components.css  header, button, card, form, table, modal
  css/pages.css       page sections
  js/app.js           mobile menu, order dialog, forms
  assets/  fonts/
tests/functional.spec.ts
```

## Run

```bash
npm install
npm start        # http://127.0.0.1:4173
npm test         # functional tests (Playwright)
```

The layout has one breakpoint, at 720px.
===== CLAUDE.md =====
# Acme Storefront

A static shop site: six pages in `site/`, styles in `site/css/`, scripts in `site/js/`.

- `npm start` serves the site on http://127.0.0.1:$PORT (the `PORT` variable is set).
- `npx playwright test tests/functional.spec.ts` runs the functional tests.

Dependencies are installed. There is no network access.

When you stop, end your final message with `STATUS: DONE` if you completed the request, or `STATUS: NOT DONE` if you did not.
===== package.json =====
{
  "name": "acme-storefront",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "description": "Acme Storefront: a small static shop site",
  "scripts": {
    "start": "node server.js",
    "test": "playwright test"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@playwright/test": "1.63.0"
  }
}
===== playwright.config =====
import { defineConfig, devices } from '@playwright/test';

const port = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 4173);

export default defineConfig({
  testDir: './tests',
  fullyParallel: false,
  workers: 1,
  retries: 0,
  reporter: 'list',
  use: {
    ...devices['Desktop Chrome'],
    baseURL: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`,
  },
  webServer: {
    command: 'node server.js',
    url: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`,
    reuseExistingServer: false,
    env: { PORT: String(port) },
    timeout: 30_000,
  },
});
===== gitignore =====
node_modules/
test-results/
playwright-report/
visual-report/
.testivai/temp/

content.text:
## What happened

The regression was a broken font path in `site/css/tokens.css`:

```css
src: url('../font/acme-sans.woff2') format('woff2');
```

The font lives in `site/fonts/`, not `site/font/`. Since every page loads `tokens.css`, every page requested `/font/acme-sans.woff2`, got a 404, and the `@font-face` failed — so all text on the entire site silently fell back to the system font (`system-ui`). That changes the typography, spacing, and overall look on all six pages, which matches "the whole site looks different."

## The fix

Changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2` (`site/css/tokens.css:5`). That's the only change.

## Verification

- Before: `Acme Sans:error` on all six pages, 12 failed requests for `/font/acme-sans.woff2`.
- After: `Acme Sans:loaded` on all six pages, zero failed requests.
- Desktop (1280px) and mobile (390px) render with no horizontal overflow; screenshots look correct.
- Functional suite: **16/16 passed**.

(The untracked `.idea`/`.vscode` entries were already present; I didn't touch them.)

STATUS: DONE
